Replaces the worms with a Animal Crossing like digspot marker. 
[/size][/center][size=2]
[b]Installation [CP][/b]
1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]ContentPatcher[/url]﻿.
2. Unzip the file into the \Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods folder.

[b]Installation [XNB][/b]
1. Backup your default files.
2. Unzip the file.
3. Place the "Cursors.xnb" file into your Stardew Valley\Content\LooseSprites folder, overwriting the old Cursors.xnb. 
If you're using Steam, the default folder path is something like C:\Program Files\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\LooseSprites. 

[i]If you're using another mod that edits Cursors.xnb (like a mod that edits the inventory screen pet heads), this will overwrite that mod. If you want to use both, let me know and I'll see what I can do.[/i]

[b]Uninstallation:[/b]
1. Delete the file.
2. Restore the backup you made.
[/size]
